view: SELECT u."ServiceCode",u."ServiceName",k."CategoryName",s."BasePrice",u."ServiceName"||' / '||k."CategoryName"||' / '||CAST(s."BasePrice" AS VARCHAR(20))||' руб./день' AS "ServiceLabel" FROM "Service" u JOIN "ServiceCategory" k ON k."CategoryCode"=u."CategoryCode" JOIN "ServicePrice" s ON s."ServiceCode"=u."ServiceCode" WHERE s."PriceDate"=(SELECT MAX(t."PriceDate") FROM "ServicePrice" t WHERE t."ServiceCode"=u."ServiceCode" AND t."PriceDate"<=CURRENT_DATE)
